title: Choose the visual world: Investigate
question: The roll assigned The Evidence Board. Keep it, take the pick or a challenger, or re-roll.

options.label: The Evidence Board
options.lineage: analyst pinboards, case files, chain-of-custody exhibits
options.thesis: The dossier is a physical evidence board: the IOC is the anchor exhibit, every source a pinned card, and the block decision a case you could defend in court.
options.viewport: The looked-up IOC lands as a stamped anchor exhibit card top-left on the cork field, verdict stamp diagonally across it, red string radiating to pinned relation cards, source-evidence strips tacked along the bottom edge.
options.risk: Lapses into prop-kit kitsch the moment string becomes decoration instead of data.

raised.raise: Exhibit nodes are sized by evidentiary weight with deliberate scale mismatch: the anchor IP huge, related domains postage-sized, never a uniform grid.
One continuous red-string path carries the eye from verdict stamp through the graph to the recommended action; sections hang off the string, not off a scroll.
Each corroborating source gets exactly one full-width strike row: stenciled cap header, tabular evidence values, chalk-rule dividers, no nested columns.

options.label: The Seismograph Station
options.lineage: seismic observatory drum recorders and station bulletins
options.thesis: Threatbase's own honeypots are sensor stations: the IOC is an earthquake, and the page is the drum record proving it.
options.viewport: A full-width 90-day strip chart runs the top of the page with station-by-station event ticks and amplitudes; below it, the bulletin: magnitude verdict, hypocenter identity, aftershock relations table.
options.risk: Where most grounded runs in this category land; the metaphor can overstay at dense-text panels.

options.label: Nixie Instrument Panel
options.thesis: Every count arrives as visible plasma: score, engines, feeds glowing inside glass tubes.
options.case: Reads as instruments the SOC trusts, but tubes carry numbers only and cannot hold dense evidence text.
options.risk: Glow-on-black is one step from the cockpit you are replacing.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Record
options.thesis: Evidence as stacked translucent sheets over an eleven-step zone ramp, where hatch density is load and crossed hatches are conflict.
options.case: The conflict-notation and tonal discipline fuse beautifully into multi-source disagreement, but a darkroom is not the analyst's daily world.
options.risk: Hatch layers turn to noise at table densities.

options.label: Azulejo Station Hall
options.lineage: tin-glazed tile halls of Portuguese rail stations
options.thesis: Cobalt-on-white tile panels narrate the case; the grout seams run straight through the scene, admitting the grid is the truth.
options.case: Blank-tile absence is the honest empty state this product needs, and the calendar is already a tile grid, but station tiles do not read as security operations.
options.risk: Decorative heritage tone undercuts threat credibility.

options.label: Tropicalia Sleeve Collage
options.case: Collage chaos defeats scanability for an evaluation surface analysts must read in seconds.
options.kept: Scale mismatch as compositional honesty, now a named raise on the board.

options.label: Googie Starburst Diner
options.case: Sun-bright futurism sells coffee, not a blocklist decision.
options.kept: The single sweeping sightline, now a named raise on the board.

options.label: Power-Hammer Forge
options.case: Heat-as-status has no true mapping to source verdicts; it would force claims the product can't make.
options.kept: One-blow-per-row discipline, now a named raise on the board.

options.label: The category standard
options.lineage: modern intel consoles (VirusTotal, Recorded Future idiom)
options.thesis: Clean score ring, tabbed panels, sortable evidence table, blue-grey calm.
options.viewport: Search bar centered, verdict ring left, tabs of evidence right, exactly as analysts expect.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from what you already shipped, by design.
